items.title: Jackie Cain and Roy Kral interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: The interviewee narrates a story about Frank Sinatra and Joe DiMaggio. The interviewee does not claim a personal relationship with DiMaggio, only that they are aware of the anecdote.

ctx.x: Someone was there that he didn’t know.

Tell him his membership is up. And the head waiter went down and talked to the guy and he came back to Frank and he says, “no, he’s all right. That’s Joe DiMaggio’s shirt maker.” And Frank says, “okay.”
That was funny you know, because he was a friend of his so he couldn’t throw his shirt maker out. That’s a true story. © Fillius Jazz Archive -20-
